newsitem.title: USA: Carbide still committed to ethylene venture.
newsitem.headline: Carbide still committed to ethylene venture.

text.p: Union Carbide Corp on Friday said it was still committed to an ethylene plant joint venture with Millennium Chemicals Inc and Lyondell Petrochemical Co but wants the start-up of the proposed 910,000-tonne-a-year plant delayed until 2002.
Last year, Eastman Chemical Co pulled out of the project, and there has been speculation that Carbide would follow.
"We are looking for another partner and are committed to working with the group," a Carbide spokesman said.
Earlier Friday, Millennium said during a conference call that the chances of finding a partner to replace Eastman were 50-50 and that it had not heard from Carbide that it had decided to pull out.
Carbide said it wanted the plant start-up delayed to 2002 from 2001 because that timetable would fit better with its ethylene demands.
